title: arctotis massoniana
intro: Arctotis massoniana, commonly known as the Cape marguerite, is a flowering plant species belonging to the daisy family (Asteraceae). It is traditionally used in herbal medicine to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Arctotis massoniana include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The plant's bioactive constituents, including flavonoids and phenolic acids, exhibit therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities.
